The video discusses how AI will transform education by replacing traditional textbooks with interactive 3D anatomical models and immersive applications. The speaker illustrates this by showing an anatomical tool built by a developer on X and contrasting flat textbook learning with interactive screen-based exploration.

This video segment discusses how AI will transform education by enabling teachers to build interactive applications for students instead of relying solely on textbooks. It concludes with a standard outro encouraging viewers to follow for daily AI content.
